title: docs(pm): the security lane charter carries the maintainer's working rules — reviewed escalation, cloud orders, close-out, intake
body:
Fixes #29726

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:安全席章程 `lanes/security.md` 写入你在本会话定的工作规则——呈你之前先经隔离复核、复杂修复开云卡、逐对象收口、修复合入即关公告、发版前呈发布与否清单、接收与读公告的规矩;误公开卡的转交读得懂了。
- 为什么改:你说「这些都应该写到你的skills」,补充评论 6595626876 又把公告收口改为合入即关、发布在发版前定;同时收掉 PR #29695 复核的三条 should-fix。
- 风险与回滚:只动席位规则文本与 `scripts/pm` 工具,不进任何发布包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。唯一行为变化是信箱门铃 `Notify: security` 多认一种「卡号」写法。
- 先看:① `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md`(新增「呈维护者」「收口」两节);② `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `notify:security` 读法;③ `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` 签名行改为导入。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`,预期四个自测全绿(record-recognisers 360 例)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S,待 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 复核 PASS)。

## What changes

**`lanes/security.md` (34 → 53 lines)** — the maintainer's working rules for the security seat, as pointers plus the minimum new text; no never-public rule is restated:

- Ruling 1 (verbatim on the card): before any question reaches the maintainer, an isolated agent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` reviews the analysis — fed the analysis and evidence, never the seat's conclusion — checking the four axes, missing options, the recommendation and the evidence; the question carries the verdict and every dissent. No model name in the text.
- Ruling 2: L/XL, build-heavy, long-running or browser-verified fix orders go `mode:cloud`, the rest `mode:subagent`, pointing at `execution-duties.md`; the seat archives each cloud card when its work lands.
- Ruling 3, the close-out per object, as amended by comment 6595626876: PR merged by the queue, MERGED confirmed before the card's close-out (pointer to `landing-operations.md`); `Fixes #N` / `Part of #N` cards; an advisory moves to `closed` through the relay `advisory_state` once its fix merges, recorded on the seat post, no per-advisory ask; cloud cards archived; a subagent ends itself and removes its worktree.
- Ruling 4 (amendment): a pre-release publish-or-not list of the advisories closed since the last release, high and moderate first, reviewed under ruling 1 first; the maintainer reopens and publishes in the advisory UI. Ledger states: `received` → `fixing` → `merged` → `closed`, and only what the pick sends to publishing goes `awaiting publish` → `published`.
- Intake and reads: a cloud seat cannot list advisories (ids come from the maintainer or the doorbell); plaintext only to the seat's own stdout with `--reveal`, never a file, a log or a background task's output; fix claims live in the seat post's ledger.
- S1: the old line 12 and line 17's clauses restated `security-findings.md` §3/§9; both are now pointers.
- S2: one sentence — **the seat's own patrol reads open `security`-labelled cards, so the label is the hand-over**; triage's doorbell only speeds it up.

**`Notify: security` reads a labelled card's number (S2's measured half).** Triage already rang `Notify: security · #29761` into the security mailbox (#29743, comment 6595011108). Measured on `origin/main` at b0ef25f524: `readMailboxLine` answered `unreadable` ("does not spell `Notify: security · GHSA-ID`"), as the PR #29695 review predicted. Of the two fixes, widening the reader is the smaller change (no new key, no new table row, no new protocol line): the one field is either the opaque advisory id or a card number, never both. An already-public card number is not a mechanism. After the change the same comment reads `{ card: 29761, numbers: [29761] }`. Template now `Notify: security · GHSA-ID or #n`.

**S3.** The `MAILBOX_KEYS` `notify:security` `from:` is now the seat holding the finding (a dev's or a QA runner's finding reaches its PM session privately first), or triage for a public card it labelled. `project-forms.md` says the same in place (still 56 lines, ≤120 bytes).

**Lane-list three-copy drift.** `fleet-roster.mjs` now imports `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` from `check-half-states.mjs` and deletes its mirror. The mirror's stated reason ("so the relay never loads the patrol") is false on this tree: `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, the relay that imports `ROSTER_MARKER`, statically imports `check-half-states.mjs` itself (line 482). So the import loads nothing new there and adds no cycle, because `check-half-states.mjs` never imports `fleet-roster.mjs`. The third copy, `mailbox-open.mjs` `SEAT_BARE_LANES`, cannot import the patrol: the patrol loads the opener lazily, and H72 pins that, so the edge would be the top-level-await deadlock measured at check-half-states.mjs:14681. It is pinned instead by a new `fleet-roster` self-test row (the only file that imports both). The signature's kinds must equal the opener's kinds plus `epic`, and its bare words the opener's bare lanes plus `coordinator`. No new gate.

**Ratchet.** `lanes/security.md` row 34 → 53, the measured delta +19. The row's comment cites the card body and amendment comment 6595626876 as the ruling record. No other row moves.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` → `✓ record-recognisers self-test: 360 cases pass` (was 359; the mailbox battery floor 40 → 41). The old refusal row dropped its `#28001` case. The new row reads `#29761` alone and refuses a card plus an id, a second field, `PR #n`, `#0` and the verbatim template.
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` → `✓ fleet-roster self-test: 105 cases in 9 batteries pass` (was 104; battery floor 13 → 14).
- `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` → `✓ mailbox-open self-test: 82 cases in 10 batteries pass`.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-time proofs, run through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs against the committed head 08f26b8bb4)</summary>

- Deleted the card-number branch of the `notify:security` reader: `✗ record-recognisers self-test: 1 of 360 case(s) failed` (the new row), restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Added a bare lane `auditor` to `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` alone: the fleet-roster lane-grammar row reds (`1 failure(s)`), restored and proven.
- Added `auditor` to `SEAT_BARE_LANES` alone: the same row reds, restored and proven.
- Direction expected and observed: red, all three.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `fleet-roster.mjs`'s `isEpicParent` header carries the same stale reason ("not imported, so the relay … never loads the patrol") for its H45 mirror. Untouched here; a note only.
- Line 61 of `security-findings.md` §9 still says "发现者 … 敲 `Notify: security · GHSA-ID`". It still reads true: §5 sends a dev's finding to its seat first. It is unchanged because the claim limits that file to pointers.
- `SKILL.md`'s `mode:*` row routes `security`-labelled cards to `thread` when a seat is a project thread. The charter's cloud rule covers the seat's no-card fix orders, a different object. No change.

## Verification

Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at 08f26b8bb4 (38 commands). Every one ran, with the exit code captured before any pipe. Reconciled: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 38 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

<details><summary>Per-command exits</summary>

All exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` (`109 file(s) clean`), `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`. One exception: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt). It exited 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock. Also run outside the derivation: the `--self-test` of each touched `scripts/pm` file (`check-skill-line-ratchet`, `fleet-roster`, `mailbox-open`, `record-recognisers`), all exit 0.

</details>

No changeset: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` ship in no released package (`skip-changeset`).
